text.content:
Once the heart of the city; now one of its poorest districts.

Region: Night City, north
Controlled by: Arasaka on the waterfront; the Tyger Claws and Maelstrom elsewhere
Feel: Neon, bazaars and megabuildings
Notable locations: Arasaka Waterfront: Konpeki Plaza. Kabuki: Ho-Oh, Kabuki Roundabout, Lizzie's Bar, No-Tell Motel. Little China: the Afterlife, Deravaja Dojo, Night City Medical Center, Riot, Tom's Diner, Urmland Street. Northside: All Foods Factory, Totentanz

The comfortable north of the city emptied in the 4th Corporate War, and the people of Old Japantown and Little China moved in. A group of Japanese corps, the Night City Co-Prosperity Sphere, poured money in and named it Watson; when the Sphere collapsed and the money moved to City Center and Westbrook, Watson fell behind.

Arasaka took the waterfront for its port and locked it down. Kabuki is a bazaar nearly as lawless as Dogtown; Little China holds the first megabuildings and the Afterlife; Northside's empty factories hide gangs, Maelstrom above all.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.20
